brief.purpose: discovery-350k wave1 attempt 1: arm reference-e-5m-s1 (reference, E, target 5000000), starts from initialization at epoch 0 in a new run directory, trained to stop epoch 1000 on one RTX 3090.

stop_rules.approval_ref: run_pack/ablation guards in the frozen bundle
stop_rules.condition: divergence, nonfinite metrics, epoch-0 divergence, fingerprint mismatch

stop_rules.approval_ref: final for the index (podFailurePolicy FailIndex on 5, 76, 124, 137, 143); backoffLimitPerIndex 1 only for a pre-arm failure (exit 75, within 600 s)
stop_rules.condition: pod activeDeadlineSeconds 47000 / run_pack timeout or a training-phase failure
CANARY_* FAIL or CONTROLLER_AUDIT FAIL in a MONITOR line

annotations.bnjettag.io/active-deadline: pod 47000 s; run_pack timeout = deadline - elapsed - 420 s; deadline (124), RSS gate (5), training-phase failure (76) and PID-1 kill (137/143) are FailIndex; a pre-arm failure within 600 s exits 75 and is retried once (PREFLIGHT fixes after review v1, A2)
annotations.bnjettag.io/arm: reference-e-5m-s1 a1 reference E budget 5000000 warmup 1 stop 1000
annotations.bnjettag.io/gpu-fingerprint: kai-chang0926-fp-e9511d1aeb sha256 e9511d1aeb39c7c8: chang1002c-a-n64-s1 initial_ebops == 11559681 before the arm
annotations.bnjettag.io/single-arm-justified: campaigns/2026-09-29-gpu-benchmark/VERIFY.md:109: RTX 3090 A07 K=1 GPU util 61.6 % all / 74.3 % steady (1 arm x 20 epochs), peak 8,484 / 24,576 MiB; one arm per GPU is the approved pilot shape (decisions.md 2026-10-05 10:08 item 2). E at K=1 is unmeasured: utilization is checked 30 min after launch (PILOT_PROGRAM.md §4).

args:
set -euo pipefail
T0=$(date +%s); ARM_PHASE=pre; ARM_FINAL_RC=""
pod_exit() { rc=$?; trap - EXIT; el=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 )); if [ "$rc" = 0 ] || [ "$rc" = 10 ]; then exit "$rc"; fi; if [ -n "$ARM_FINAL_RC" ]; then echo "POD_EXIT_FINAL rc=$rc exit=$ARM_FINAL_RC elapsed_s=$el"; exit "$ARM_FINAL_RC"; fi; if [ "$ARM_PHASE" = pre ] && [ "$el" -lt 600 ]; then echo "POD_EXIT_RETRYABLE rc=$rc phase=pre elapsed_s=$el exit=75"; exit 75; fi; echo "POD_EXIT_FINAL rc=$rc phase=$ARM_PHASE elapsed_s=$el exit=76"; exit 76; }
trap pod_exit EXIT
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p /work/code
echo '36ce60986d541308cd355ffb266203f9bce326a660d88b6adacae3e42cec4b56  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
export BNJ_DATA_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926 BNJ_RUN_ROOT=/data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/reference-e-5m-s1-a1 BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/d350
export BNJ_STAGE=production
export TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=true NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0
unset WANDB_PROJECT
export WANDB_ENTITY=kayamaguchi-uc-san-diego WANDB_MODE=online
export WANDB_TAGS=d350,discovery-350k,wave1,a1,validation-only
export WANDB_DIR=/work WANDB_CACHE_DIR=/work/wandb-cache WANDB_DATA_DIR=/work/wandb-data WANDB_DISABLE_CODE=true WANDB_QUIET=true
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-training.txt
NVLIBS=$(python -c "import glob; print(':'.join(sorted(glob.glob('/usr/local/lib/python*/site-packages/nvidia/*/lib'))))")
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$NVLIBS${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "e6ff034bfc44580a44fc96a27fedcd302f43babbef70169e90802f4ea9a0a8e3" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
export BNHGQ2_CODE_SHA256="$MSHA"
python -c "import tensorflow as tf; assert tf.config.list_physical_devices('GPU'); print('GPU_GATE_PASS')"
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || { echo "CACHE_NOT_READY"; exit 1; }
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv,noheader || true
df -h /data
echo 'e9511d1aeb39c7c8e48cc7dbc148ac623f3b2d9844d108da38f1ecfa2bdff1f1  /cmfp/fingerprint_check.py' | sha256sum -c -
FP=0
python -u /cmfp/fingerprint_check.py --run chang1002c-a-n64-s1 --expect 11559681 --data-root /data/chang-n64-20260926 --campaign-dir /work/code/campaigns/chang1002c --env-report || FP=$?
if [ "$FP" != 0 ]; then echo "FINGERPRINT_GATE_FAIL exit=$FP node=${NODE_NAME:-na}; no arm started"; exit "$FP"; fi
( while sleep 60; do echo "GPU_SAMPLE $(date -u +%FT%TZ) $(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits | tr -d ' ')"; done ) &
SMI=$!
( while sleep 1800; do test -s /data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/reference-e-5m-s1-a1/runs/d350-reference-e-5m-s1/pid_telemetry.jsonl || continue; python -u /work/code/campaigns/d350/monitor_p.py --config /work/code/campaigns/d350/configs/d350-reference-e-5m-s1.json --telemetry /data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/reference-e-5m-s1-a1/runs/d350-reference-e-5m-s1/pid_telemetry.jsonl | sed "s/^/MONITOR /" || echo "MONITOR_ERROR d350-reference-e-5m-s1"; done ) &
MON=$!
PACKS=packs/d350-reference-e-5m-s1.json
RP=0; E0=0
ARM_PHASE=train
ARM_BUDGET_S=$(( 47000 - ($(date +%s) - T0) - 420 ))
echo "ARM_DEADLINE pod_deadline_s=47000 run_pack_budget_s=$ARM_BUDGET_S"
if [ "$ARM_BUDGET_S" -le 0 ]; then ARM_FINAL_RC=124; echo "ARM_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED d350-reference-e-5m-s1 before_start"; exit 124; fi
TS=$(date +%s)
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=150 "$ARM_BUDGET_S" python -u /work/code/run_pack.py "$PACKS" 1000 || RP=$?
if [ "$RP" = 124 ] || { [ "$RP" = 137 ] && [ $(( $(date +%s) - TS )) -ge "$ARM_BUDGET_S" ]; }; then ARM_FINAL_RC=124; echo "ARM_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED d350-reference-e-5m-s1 run_pack_exit=$RP budget_s=$ARM_BUDGET_S"; fi
kill "$SMI" $MON 2>/dev/null || true
python - "$PACKS" <<'PY' || E0=$?
import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
camp = Path(os.environ['BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR'])
runs = Path(os.environ['BNJ_RUN_ROOT']) / 'runs'
pack = json.loads((camp / sys.argv[1]).read_text())[int(os.environ['JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX'])]
rows = json.loads((camp / 'index.json').read_text())['runs']
seen = []
for i in pack:
    marker = runs / rows[i]['name'] / 'DIVERGED.json'
    seen.append((rows[i]['name'], json.loads(marker.read_text()).get('divergence_epoch_zero_based') if marker.exists() else None))
print('PACK_EPOCH0_CHECK', ' '.join(f'{n}={e}' for n, e in seen), flush=True)
sys.exit(10 if seen and all(e == 0 for _, e in seen) else 0)
PY
if [ "$E0" = 10 ]; then echo "POD_EPOCH0_ALL_DIVERGED node=${NODE_NAME:-na} run_pack_exit=$RP"; exit 10; fi
if [ "$E0" != 0 ]; then echo "PACK_EPOCH0_CHECK_ERROR $E0"; fi
test -s /data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/reference-e-5m-s1-a1/runs/d350-reference-e-5m-s1/pid_telemetry.jsonl && python -u /work/code/campaigns/d350/monitor_p.py --config /work/code/campaigns/d350/configs/d350-reference-e-5m-s1.json --telemetry /data/discovery-350k-20261008/attempts/reference-e-5m-s1-a1/runs/d350-reference-e-5m-s1/pid_telemetry.jsonl | sed "s/^/FINAL /" || echo "FINAL_MONITOR_MISSING d350-reference-e-5m-s1"
echo "PILOT_ARM_DONE d350-reference-e-5m-s1 run_pack_exit=$RP"
exit "$RP"
containers.name: train
